description: This file contains test utilities for HTTP/2 adapter, including classes and functions for creating and handling data frames, headers, and frame matching for testing purposes.

classes.name: TestDataFrameSource
classes.description: A class for simulating data frame source in tests, managing payload appending, selection, and sending.

classes.name: TestMetadataSource
classes.description: A class for providing header metadata in tests, encoding headers and packing data.

classes.name: SpdyControlFrameMatcher
classes.description: A custom Google Mock matcher for verifying SPDY control frames in test data.

methods.name: AppendPayload
methods.description: Appends payload data to the data frame source.

methods.name: EndData
methods.description: Marks the end of data in the source.

methods.name: SelectPayloadLength
methods.description: Selects the payload length for sending, considering max length and error conditions.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a data frame with specified header and payload length, handling errors.

methods.name: EncodeHeaders
methods.description: Encodes HTTP/2 headers into a header block.

methods.name: Pack
methods.description: Packs encoded header data into a destination buffer.
